title: English: Weather & Time ⛅
summary:
1. Weather Words:
Sunny, hot, windy, rainy, snowy, foggy, cool, wet, dry, warm, cold, and freezing.

2. Present Continuous (am/is/are + ing):
We use this to talk about things happening right now!
• I am wearing a coat.
• He/She/It is raining.
• We/They are playing.

3. Short Forms:
• I am ➔ I'm
• We are ➔ We're
• They are ➔ They're
• He is ➔ He's

4. In / On / At:
• On: for days of the week (on Monday, on Friday). Remember to use a Capital Letter for days!
• In: for parts of the day or seasons (in the morning, in the summer).
• At: for night or weekend (at night, at the weekend).

5. Making Questions:
Swap the first two words! It is rainy. ➔ Is it rainy?
